thread:
maria: quick follow-up from the authz postmortem. root cause = token-validator GC pause + blocking JWKS fetch. need owners for hotfix, audit events, secrets rotation, and a short verification cadence. tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AuthzActions

devsec-bot: INCIDENT RDW-2026-318 recorded: authz token validation spike 2026-03-22 11:12-11:48 UTC. impact: hosted api + several eu-west-1 dedicated customers. logs: https://logs.redwood.example/incident/2026-318

jamie: i'll take the hotfix 1: add cache fallback + simple circuit-breaker around jwks fetch; aim: patch to staging 03/26 EOD, canary 03/27 morning. will add runbook snippet to tracker.

alex: i'll own telemetry + audit events. will add jwks_fetch_latency histogram and authz.audit events with fields (tenant_id, token_hash, verdict, error_code). PR to staging today.

tanya: i'll draft customer comms and hold until canary green. will segment hosted vs dedicated notes.

infra-bot: Canary scheduled: token-validator v2.hotfix -> 03/27 02:30 UTC -> 5% traffic. rollback if >1% validation failures for 10m.

devsec-bot: remediation ticket RDW-SEC-12458 created: rotate token-validator service principal + verify secrets. proposed window 03/28 02:00-04:00 UTC.

jamie: runbook snippet (short) i'll paste in tracker:
```
if jwks_fetch_latency_ms > 500:
  use_cached_jwks()
  backoff_jwks_fetch()
  emit_metric("authz.jwks.block")
if cached_jwks_age_s > 60:
  page("eng-oncall")
```

alex: quick query to separate tenant noise from platform issues:
```
index=authz.audit (error_code=JWKS_FETCH_FAIL OR verdict=FAIL) | stats count by tenant_id, error_code
```
this will help prioritize alerts and avoid noisy pages.

maria: proposed cadence: short "token-health" check-in weekly 15m for 6 weeks starting 03/30, plus daily synthetic checks 7 days post-deploy. i've added calendar invites. please confirm owners in the tracker and ack here with :eyes:.

jamie: :eyes: confirmed owner for hotfix + runbook (03/26).

alex: :eyes: confirmed telemetry + audit (03/28).

tanya: :eyes: ill hold comms until canary & runbook are done.

maria: thanks. if anything slips update the sheet and ping me directly.
